title: Mamiya RZ67 Professional 6x7 Medium Format SLR
purpose: Intimate close-up character portraiture with twin vertical catchlights, resolving epidermal pores and wrinkles under soft daylight-balanced Kino Flo illumination.

sensor_and_optics.camera_system: Mamiya RZ67 Professional 6x7 Medium Format SLR
sensor_and_optics.sensor_type: 6x7 medium format film negative (56x70mm revolving back)
sensor_and_optics.full_frame_equivalent: ~70mm portrait field of view with massive 6x7 negative area
sensor_and_optics.iso_base: Kodak Professional Portra 800 color negative film
sensor_and_optics.dynamic_range: 14 stops color negative latitude with organic skin tone roll-off
sensor_and_optics.shutter: Electronic leaf shutter in lens with 1/400s flash sync

lighting_and_exposure.primary_lighting: Two soft vertical fluorescent light banks (Kino Flo) on both sides of the face, even frontal illumination

Kodak Portra 800 organic grain and authentic skin undertones without plastic digital smoothing

depth_and_optics: 140mm macro optical compression: tight portrait framing with the face filling the frame
